review.oracle_audit: Audit of all 250 generator-defined recipes (84 FractionMix, 82 PolicyPick, 84 ListPatch; 2 public per task, 82/80/82 hidden) completed against the exact task contracts. In FractionMix, all rational additions are exact, reductions by GCD are verified, zero returns exact 0/1, and the 7331-digit coprime power test agrees with the independent common denominator product without triggering CPython's 4300-digit limit. In PolicyPick, literal string handling, 64-byte UTF-8 boundaries, surrogate/control character rejections, literal Unicode code point tie-breaking, set subset semantics, tag deduplication, and late invalid rule atomicity are rigorously exercised. In ListPatch, 1-based/0-based bounds, atomic sequential updates, transient length-1001 overflow rejections, invalid op forms, delete property restrictions, and negative-zero integer handling match specifications. The output parser uses JsonInteger lexemes via custom parse_int, decoupled from global int conversion limits, rejects duplicate keys via unique_pairs, and rejects non-finite/floating constants. Subjects run hermetically with network=none, read-only delivery mounts, cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, 3s execution limits, and persistent JobStore journals preventing replay or silent restart. Stdin ordering finite observer trace verification correctly tracks syscalls without asserting authority over captured streams.
review.rationale: The supplied evaluator and oracle sources (reserved.py, subjects.py, tests, and task contracts) satisfy all scoping requirements: complete source coverage without omitted-code hashes, deterministic pre-selected recipe counts totaling exactly 250, strict type and boundary validations, complete decoupling from delivery authors, and robust isolation mechanisms. Readiness is strictly scoped to the evaluator/oracle subsystem; comparison registration readiness remains false pending full campaign harness freeze, sequence preregistration, and completion of the required 9-phase delivery milestone.
